_comment: Tiny sample of `gcloud asset search-all-iam-policies --format=json` output. Run that read-only command yourself and feed the real file to `agenthound gcp --import <file>`. AgentHound never calls GCP. Escalation story: user:dev can impersonate the ci-deployer service account (serviceAccountTokenCreator), and ci-deployer is roles/owner on the project — so a non-admin user reaches owner via impersonation. Admin comes from the roles/owner binding, never from a name.
